# ClankVox

> ClankVox is Clanky's main Rust package for voice and media transport. Its Discord implementation covers RTP, Opus, DAVE, H264/VP8, playback pacing, Go Live, and JSON-line IPC.

## Start

- [Overview](https://volpestyle.github.io/docs/clankvox/?doc=overview): What users get from ClankVox, what Clanky delegates to it, and the media-plane mental model.

## Architecture

- [System Diagram](https://volpestyle.github.io/docs/clankvox/?doc=diagram): Media-plane map for Clanky, JSON-line IPC, ClankVox transport implementations, audio, and video.
- [Architecture](https://volpestyle.github.io/docs/clankvox/?doc=architecture): Ownership boundaries, process model, core state, transport roles, IPC, and module map.

## Media

- [Audio Pipeline](https://volpestyle.github.io/docs/clankvox/?doc=audio-pipeline): Inbound capture, outbound TTS/music playback, 20ms pacing, telemetry, and floor-control signals.
- [Go Live](https://volpestyle.github.io/docs/clankvox/?doc=go-live): Native screen watch, self publish, stream discovery, stream roles, DAVE, and video transport.

## Operations

- [Development](https://volpestyle.github.io/docs/clankvox/?doc=development): Build and test commands, logging knobs, high-value edit locations, and Clanky coordination points.
